basic_details.job_title: NCSK Recruitment 2027 – Apply Offline for 12 LDC, Assistant and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The National Commission for Safai Karamcharis (NCSK), New Delhi, under the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of India, is filling 12 posts on deputation and short-term contract, initially for one year. The posts are Deputy Director (R & D), Assistant Director, Section Officer, Private Secretary, Research Assistant (R & D), Senior Hindi Translator, Lower Division Clerk (4), Assistant (Accounts) and Steno Grade-D. Serving officials of Central or State Government, UTs and PSUs, retired government servants and qualified professionals can apply. Applications go to the Commissio

how_to_apply: Serving officers of Central Government/State Govt/PSU apply through proper channel in the prescribed format. Their Cadre Controlling Authority or Head of Department forwards the application. Only officers whose services can be spared on deputation immediately on selection should be forwarded.
Retired Government officers send the filled application (format attached to the notice) with a copy of their PPO.
Qualified professionals send the filled application (format attached to the notice) with complete experience details.
Send the complete application with documents to: Assistant Director (R & D), National Commission for Safai Karamcharis, 4th Floor, 'B' Wing, Lok Nayak Bhawan, Khan Market, New Delhi-110003.
Applications may also be sent by e-mail to [email protected] & [email protected].
Applications must be submitted by 04 January 2027.
The detailed advertisement and application form are also on the Commission's website, ncsk.nic.in.
Serving officers applying through proper channel must attach:
Application in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-I), with a recent passport size photograph pasted on it
Cadre Clearance Certificate from the Cadre Controlling Authority (Annexure-II)
Statement giving details of Major/Minor penalties imposed during the last ten (10) years
Photocopies of ACRs/APARs for the last five (5) years, attested on each page by an officer not below the level of Under Secretary or equivalent
Certification by the Cadre Controlling Authority that the particulars furnished by the officer are correct

The consultant proforma for retired servants asks for copies of the PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, PPO and LPC, and bank details. Qualified professionals attach complete experience details. Their form asks for educational qualifications from Matriculation onwards and professional/technical qualifications.
important_instructions: Applications received after the last date or otherwise found incomplete shall not be entertained. The Cadre Controlling Authority must certify that the officer, if selected, will be relieved immediately. It must also certify that integrity is beyond doubt and that no vigilance case is pending. If a penalty has been imposed during the last 10 years, a penalty statement may be enclosed instead of the no-penalty certificate. Retired applicants declare that they were clear from the vigilance angle at retirement. They must also declare that no disciplinary or judicial action is pending against them. For queries, contact Telephone No. 24618119. The notice is signed by Raj Kapil, Consultant (A & C), Tel No. 24649354.

content_sections.heading: About NCSK
content_sections.text: The National Commission for Safai Karamcharis is a commission under the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of India, with its office at 'B' Wing, 4th Floor, Lok Nayak Bhawan, Khan Market, New Delhi-110003. The notice says these engagements are being made to strengthen the working infrastructure of the Commission.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 12 vacancies across nine posts. For each post, the Commission accepts applications from three groups: serving officials, retired officials and qualified professionals.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The age limit is the same for every post. Serving officials should not be more than 45 years of age. Retired officials should not be more than 62 years of age. Qualified professionals should not be more than 45 years of age. The notice leaves the "As on" date for age blank, so no cut-off date is printed. Serving officials: Must be serving in analogous or preferably higher posts of Central Government/State Govt/UTs and PSUs. Preference goes to officers with experience in making presentations and reports, analysing data, and devising policy and schemes. Knowledge of English and Hindi writing, computers and E-office is also preferred. Retired officials: Must have superannuated from analogous or higher posts of Central Government/State Govt/UTs and PSUs. The same preference applies, with knowledge of English and Hindi writing/computers. Qualified professionals: Graduates/Professional Graduates (CA, MBA, LLB, CS, ICWA, etc.) with 10 years of experience in relevant field of Government Sector. The same preference applies. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Pay depends on the type of applicant: Serving officials (deputation): Pay is as per Govt. Rules for deputation, for every post. Retired officials: Remuneration is as per the Department of Expenditure's O.M. No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020 for Retired Government Servants, for every post. Qualified professionals get a fixed remuneration on short-term contract, set by experience: The deputation, contractual or short-term contract period is initially 01 year. It can be extended based on requirement and the individual's satisfactory performance. Deputation allowance will be paid as per existing rules. Terms of deputation are governed by DOP&T's O.M. No. 6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010 and Government instructions issued from time to time.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NCSK Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 12 vacancies across nine posts, including 4 posts of Lower Division Clerk and 1 post each for the other eight posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NCSK Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of application is 04 January 2027. Late or incomplete applications will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for qualified professionals?
faq.answer: The qualification depends on the post. Examples: Graduation in any discipline for Lower Division Clerk, Graduation in Commerce for Assistant (Accounts), 12th pass or higher with stenography for Steno Grade-D, and Graduates/Professional Graduates with 10 years of Government Sector experience for Deputy Director (R & D).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NCSK Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Serving officials and qualified professionals should not be more than 45 years of age. Retired officials should not be more than 62 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary in NCSK Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualified professionals get a fixed remuneration based on post and experience, from ₹35,000 to ₹70,000 (Lower Division Clerk) up to ₹1,10,000 to ₹1,60,000 (Deputy Director (R & D)). Serving officials are paid as per Govt. rules for deputation.

faq.question: Q6. Can retired government employees apply, and how is their pay fixed?
faq.answer: Yes. Retired officials of Central Government/State Govt/UTs and PSUs up to 62 years of age can apply. Their remuneration is as per the Department of Expenditure's O.M. No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for NCSK Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the filled application in the prescribed format, with documents, to Assistant Director (R & D), National Commission for Safai Karamcharis, 4th Floor, 'B' Wing, Lok Nayak Bhawan, Khan Market, New Delhi-110003. Serving officers apply through proper channel.

faq.question: Q8. Can the NCSK application be sent by e-mail?
faq.answer: Yes. The application may also be sent by e-mail to [email protected] & [email protected].

faq.question: Q9. Is the NCSK job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is on deputation or short-term contract, initially for 01 year. It can be extended based on requirement and satisfactory performance.
